main_text.p: ΦΩΚΟΣ ΕΙΠΕΝ · ΟΠΩΣ ΑΝ Η ΒΟΥ-ΛΗ ΑΓΗ͂ ΤΑ ΑΓΑΤΟΥΡΙΑ ΜΕΤΑ ΤΩΝ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΑΘΗΝΑΙΩΝ ΚΑΤΑ ΤΑ ΠΑΤΡΙΑ. ΕΨΗΦΙΣΘΑΙ ΤΗ͂ ΒΟΥ-ΛΗ͂ ΑΦΕΙΣΘΑΙ ΤΟΥΣ ΒΟΥΛΕΥΤΑΣ ΤΑΣ ΗΜΕΡΑΣ, ΑΣΠΕΡ ΚΑΙ ΑΙ ΑΑ-ΛΑΙ ΒΟΥΛΑΙ ΔΙΑΦΙΕΝΤΑΙ, ΑΠΟ ΤΗΣ ΗΜΕΡΑΣ, ΗΣ ΟΙ ΠΡΟΤΕΝΘΑΙ ΑΓΟΥΣΙ ΓΕΝΤΕ ΗΜΕΡΑΣ.

p.i: Phocus dixit: Senatus Apaturiorum festum agitet cum aliis Atheniensibus secundum instituta patria. Senatores feriantur tot diebus, per quot reliquæ curiæ vacant. quinque nempe diebus, ab eo quem Protenthæ celebrant.

main_text.p: Senatusconsultum iftud eft, non in Areopago factum, vt volebat Vir Incomparabilis, fed in Senatu Quingentorum, qui fimpliciter ἡ βουλὴ appellatur: Pfephifma effe Senatus indicant ifta eius verba ΕΤΗΦΙΣΘΑΙ ΤΗ͂ ΒΟΥΛΗ. An vero poftea à populo ratum habitum fit Pfephifmate fuo, iuxta cuius ignarifsimus fcio: Tempus Pfephifmatis facti illud effe, quod dixi-mus, indicat Athenæus Libro IV. [illegible, ~60 letters] ΦΩΚΟΣ ΕΙΠΕΝ, &c. Non ignoro Archontem eiusdem nominis fignafse Faltos anni fecundi Olympiadis centefimæ quartæ decimæ, fed magis inclino ad Archontem anni tertij Olympiadis centefimæ tertiæ. Hoc Pfephifmate decernitur, vt Senatus Quingentorum Apaturiorum feftum quinque agitet diebus, quot nimirum celebrabant Protenthæ. Apaturia tribus diebus propiè tranfigebatur: fed tamen fequens μεθ᾽ ἡμέραν dies, quam ἐπὶ τῷ dixerunt, etiam cum feftivitate peragebatur; colligo è Simplicio ad Lib. IV. Phyfic. Κυρίως δὲ [?] ἡ ἑορτὴ Απατουρίων, ὥσπερ ἡ Δορπία, καὶ ἡ Ἀναβρύσεως, καὶ ἡ Ἐπίδαυ[?]. item-que ex Hefychio, Απατούρια, ἑορτὴ Αθηναίων ἐπὶ πεντήκοντα ἡμέρας. ὧν ἡ μὲν ἑορτὴ Δορπία, ἡ δὲ Ἀναβρύσεως, ἡ πέμπτη, Κυρεὼς · ἡ πέμπτη, ἑορτὴ Ἐπίδαυ. Protenthæ vt verò, qui hoc maxime videntur celebraffe feftum, vt verba huius Pfephifmatis indicant, & indicio eft Philyllius in Hercule:
βύλεσθ᾽ δῆτ᾽ ἐγὼ φερέσω τίς εἰμ᾽ ἐγώ; / ὦ τῇ Πεγχαίων Δορπία καλυμβῶν.

feftum hoc vno die anteuertebant, quem etiam, vt ex hoc Pfephifmate liquet, genialiter & cum feftiuitate tranfigebant. Quare feftiuiffimus Ariftophanes ὡς ταὐτὸν Νεφέλαις, vno die praecurrere dicit effe Protenthiarum fungi officio: verba eius funt:
πῶς δ᾽ ἡ Δήμητερ δῆτα τὴ ῥαμβοῖα / ἐφαλ᾽ ἰὼ (οὐ πρότερον) ἀλλ᾽ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρα; / ὁ ὅτι εἶ Γεγθέτη (ἠ δὲ ὀδοῦσ᾽ μὴ πάχυς, / ἵ᾽ ὡς ἰδίχι τὰ Πρυτάνεων ἀφελαίας. / ἐφ᾽ ὅ ἐπὶ τὸν ἀνῳ ὑπὸ ἡμέρας μίαν.
Quinque igitur dies Apaturiorum feftô agitado impendebant Protenthæ, quot etiam à Senatoribus feriatos & feftos haberi voluit hoc Pfephifmate Phocus.

Accipiebant, de publico pecuniam Senatores, honorarium illius operæ, quâ Reipublicæ impendebat. Vlpianus in Timocratea: ὑ μόνοι οἱ ἱκετεύειν ἐλάμ-βανον μισθόν, ἀλλὰ τῇ βουλῇ. Honorariū hoc erat in diem drachma. Hefychius:

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek lines after "Athenæus Libro IV." and in the Simplicius and Hesychius passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution; they are marked [?] or illegible rather than guessed. The Aristophanes and Philyllius verse lines are transcribed from a low-resolution scan, and several word-forms in them are uncertain. The Greek in the left column is clear enough, though "ΕΙΠΕΝ" and the accents could not all be confirmed. A faint watermark at the bottom right was ignored. Notes that the Latin column is set in italic and forms part of the main text, not a margin.
